title: 2021年12月四级真题 第2套 阅读2
paperTitle: 2021年12月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
passage:
P1 Nationwide, only about three percent of early childhood teachers are male in the U.S. Experts say this can have an impact on young children whose understanding of gender roles and identity are rapidly forming. Research has found that having access to diverse teachers is beneficial for children. For the youngest learners, it means they are more likely to get exposed to different varieties of play and communication. It also helps them develop healthy ideas around gender.

P2 "In our world and our society, we have very specific stereotypes(模式化形象) of gender roles," said Mindi Reich-Shapiro, an assistant professor in the teacher education department of the Borough of Manhattan Community College, and one of the authors of a recent study. "It's important for children to see other possibilities and other paths they can take."

P3 Despite mostly feeling supported by colleagues and family members, many of the male educators surveyed in the study reported facing social or cultural resistance in their careers as early education teachers. Some also reported that there were parents surprised or concerned that their child had a male teacher. And they had been advised by colleagues or other staff not to hug children.

P4 Reich-Shapiro and fellow researchers made several recommendations to increase male representation in the field. Low pay has long been acknowledged as a major issue in the early childhood field. Over 70% of male educators who said they intended to stay in the early education workforce noted an increased salary was a major motivating factor for them to commit to the career long-term. The report suggests paying all early childhood educators the way elementary school teachers are paid.

P5 Cities and programs should establish support groups for male early childhood educators and provide mentoring and professional development advice for male educators and their program leaders.

P6 The authors also suggest that traditional recruitment approaches for early childhood educators "do not address the gender gap in the field." They recommend providing young men opportunities to work with children through training and volunteer programs, targeting groups of men who are considering a career change, such as fathers.

questions.q: What do we learn from the first paragraph about early childhood education in the U.S.?
options: It helps raise children's awareness of gender roles.
It exposes children to different ways of interaction.
It is negatively impacted by a lack of male teachers.
It clearly aims to form children's identity through play.
questions.explain:
【判型】What do we learn from the first paragraph about early childhood education in the U.S.?是典型的「从某段我们了解到什么」句式，要的是段内已写明的客观信息，而非推断或 主旨。 51. What do we learn from the first paragraph about early childhood education in the U.S.? A) It helps raise children's awareness of gender roles. B) It exposes children to different ways of interaction. C) It is negatively impacted by a lack of male teachers. D) It clearly aims to form children's identity through play.

【拆句】题干What do we learn from the first paragraph about early childhood education in the U.S.?是个特殊疑问句，主干是 What do we learn from the first paragraph，about early childhood education in the U.S. 是 learn 的话题补足，整体平铺直叙、无陷阱。

【定位】Nationwide, only about three percent of early childhood teachers are male in the U.S. Experts say this can have an impact on young children whose understanding of gender roles and identity are rapidly forming. 全美范围内，幼教队伍中男性仅约百分之三。专家说这会对处于性别角色与身份认知快速形 成期的幼儿产生影响。

【选项】A) 与原文相反 It helps raise children's awareness of gender roles.说幼教「帮助提升」孩子的性别 角色意识，但原文只说男教师缺失「影响」孩子正在形成的性别角色认知，并未说幼教 在主动培养这种意识，把「被动塑造期」误读为「主动培养」。 B) 张冠李戴 It exposes children to different ways of interaction.说的是文中「师资多样性」才能 带来的好处，原文限定语是having access to diverse teachers，而题干问的是 early childhood education 整体——把条件子句的局部好处当成整体属性，是张冠李戴。 C) ✓ 正确 only about three percent of early childhood teachers are male ↔a lack of male teachers this can have an impact on young children ↔negatively impacted 预判是「男教师缺失带来负面影响」，It is negatively impacted by a lack of male teachers.正好把「缺失」与「负面影响」两块信息都点到了，是定位句的浓缩同义版。 D) 过度推断 It clearly aims to form children's identity through play.说幼教「明确以通过游戏塑造 孩子身份为目标」，原文只提到孩子的性别角色与身份处在「快速形成期」，并未说幼 教把这当成目标，且 through play 只是different varieties of play and communication里的一部分，被拿来当整体目标。 Mindi Reich-Shapiro在评论幼儿教育时强调了什么? A) 拓宽儿童视野的重要性。 B) 父亲对儿童成长的责任。 C) 创建教师教育项目的紧迫性。 D) 教师在激励儿童学习方面的作用。

questions.q: What does Mindi Reich-Shapiro emphasize in her comment on childhood education?
options: The importance of broadening children's horizons.
The responsibilities of fathers for children's growth.
The urgency of creating teacher education programs.
The role of teachers in motivating children to learn.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does Mindi Reich-Shapiro emphasize in her comment on childhood education?问的是某具体人物在评论中强调的内容，答案就在她说的话里，不是全篇主旨。 52. What does Mindi Reich-Shapiro emphasize in her comment on childhood education? A) The importance of broadening children's horizons. B) The responsibilities of fathers for children's growth. C) The urgency of creating teacher education programs. D) The role of teachers in motivating children to learn.

【拆句】题干What does Mindi Reich-Shapiro emphasize in her comment on childhood education?主干是 What does Mindi Reich-Shapiro emphasize，in her comment on childhood education 是状语限定语境，结构清晰、无陷阱。

【定位】It's important for children to see other possibilities and other paths they can take. 对孩子来说，看到其他可能性、看到他们可以走的其他道路，是很重要的。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 see other possibilities and other paths they can take ↔broadening children's horizons It's important for children ↔The importance of 预判强调「让孩子看到其他可能性」，The importance of broadening children's horizons.正是这句话的抽象浓缩，二者覆盖范围完全重合。 B) 张冠李戴 The responsibilities of fathers for children's growth.说的是父亲的责任，但 Reich- Shapiro 在P2里通篇没提父亲——把同一篇文章后段such as fathers里出现的「父亲」 嫁接到她头上，是张冠李戴。 C) 偷换概念 The urgency of creating teacher education programs.谈的是建立教师教育项目的紧 迫性，原文里 Reich-Shapiro 只是在the teacher education department任职，但她在 P2里强调的是孩子的认知拓展，而非项目建设——利用她的所属系名做诱饵。 D) 过度推断 The role of teachers in motivating children to learn.说的是教师在激励孩子学习中的 作用，但原文里 Reich-Shapiro 谈的是让孩子看到不同可能，根本没提到学习动机或激 励——把「看到可能」过度推断成「激励学习」。 从研究中男性教师的回应我们了解到什么? A) 他们中的一些人在拥抱儿童时感到尴尬。 B) 他们感到有压力要跟上女性同事的步伐。 C) 他们发现很难满足孩子家长的期望。 D) 他们中的许多人感到在社会和文化上受到偏见对待。

questions.q: What do we learn about male teachers from their responses in the study?
options: Some of them find it awkward when hugging children.
They feel pressured to keep up with female colleagues.
They find it hard to meet the expectations of kids' parents.
Many of them feel prejudiced against socially and culturally.
questions.explain:
【判型】What do we learn about male teachers from their responses in the study?要的是受访 男教师在调查中说了什么，是研究汇报里的显性细节。

【拆句】题干What do we learn about male teachers from their responses in the study?主干是 What do we learn about male teachers，from their responses in the study 是介词短 语状语限定信息来源，整句结构平直、无陷阱。 53. What do we learn about male teachers from their responses in the study? A) Some of them find it awkward when hugging children. B) They feel pressured to keep up with female colleagues. C) They find it hard to meet the expectations of kids' parents. D) Many of them feel prejudiced against socially and culturally.

【定位】Despite mostly feeling supported by colleagues and family members, many of the male educators surveyed in the study reported facing social or cultural resistance in their careers as early education teachers. 尽管大多数人觉得获得了同事与家人的支持，许多受访男幼教仍然反映在职业中遇到社会或 文化层面的阻力。

【选项】A) 偷换概念 Some of them find it awkward when hugging children.说的是男教师自己觉得拥抱 孩子尴尬；原文是they had been advised by colleagues or other staff not to hug children——是同事的建议，不是男教师本人的主观感受。 B) 无中生有 They feel pressured to keep up with female colleagues.说他们感到要「追赶女同 事」的压力，但原文从未做男女教师之间的对照，更没说要 keep up with 女同事—— 属于无中生有。 C) 过度推断 They find it hard to meet the expectations of kids' parents.说男教师「难以达到家 长期望」，但原文只说有些家长surprised or concerned孩子有男教师，并没说家长对 他们提出了某种「期望」，更没说他们「达不到」——是过度推断。 D) ✓ 正确 many of the male educators ↔Many of them facing social or cultural resistance ↔feel prejudiced against socially and culturally 预判直击「许多男教师感到社会文化层面的不接纳」，Many of them feel prejudiced against socially and culturally.在主体（many of them）、情感（feel prejudiced against）、范围（socially and culturally）三块都完全咬合。 男性投身幼儿教育需要什么? A) 更高的薪酬。 B) 工作保障。 C) 社会认可。 D) 更好的工作条件。

questions.q: What is needed for men to commit to early childhood education?
options: Higher pay.
Job security.
Social recognition.
Better working conditions.
questions.explain:
【判型】What is needed for men to commit to early childhood education?问的是文章显性提到 的留任条件，答案是原文中具体写出的因素。

【拆句】题干What is needed for men to commit to early childhood education?主干是 What is needed，for men to commit to early childhood education 是不定式短语作状语表「为 了…」，结构简单、无陷阱。 54. What is needed for men to commit to early childhood education? A) Higher pay. B) Job security. C) Social recognition. D) Better working conditions.

【定位】Over 70% of male educators who said they intended to stay in the early education workforce noted an increased salary was a major motivating factor for them to commit to the career long-term. 在那些表示打算留在幼教队伍的男教师里，超过百分之七十的人指出涨薪是他们长期投身这 一职业的主要动因。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 an increased salary ↔Higher pay a major motivating factor for them to commit to the career long-term ↔ What is needed for men to commit to early childhood education? 预判明确指向「涨薪」，Higher pay.就是这一信息最直接、最简洁的同义版本，没有附 加任何原文未明的内容。 B) 无中生有 Job security.说的是工作稳定性或保障，原文虽提到男教师「打算留下来」，但讲的是 个人意愿，并未把「工作保障」作为留下来所需的条件——属于无中生有。 C) 张冠李戴 Social recognition.谈的是社会层面的认可，原文里「社会文化阻力」出现于P3，而第 54题的定位段P4谈的是薪资动因——选项把第53题段的话题张冠李戴到第54题。 D) 以偏概全 Better working conditions.说的是更好的工作条件——它是更宽的概念，可能包括薪资 也可能不包括；但原文明确把动因点到「涨薪」，并未把笼统的「工作条件」列为动 因，选项以偏概全。 研究作者建议采取什么措施来缩小幼儿教育中的性别差距? A) 招募对幼儿教育有热情的年轻男性。 B) 采取措施吸引有意向的男性教师到该领域工作。 C) 说服准父亲们考虑改变他们的职业生涯。 D) 为男性教师提供更多晋升机会。

questions.q: What do the authors of the study recommend to bridge the gender gap in early childhood education?
options: Recruiting young men who have a passion for educating young children.
Taking measures to attract prospective male teachers to work in the field.
Persuading prospective fathers to consider a change in their career.
Providing male teachers with more opportunities for advancement.
questions.explain:
【判型】What do the authors of the study recommend to bridge the gender gap in early childhood education?问的是作者明文给出的建议，是显性细节而非主旨。

【拆句】题干What do the authors of the study recommend to bridge the gender gap in early childhood education?主干是 What do the authors of the study recommend，to bridge the gender gap in early childhood education 是不定式短语作状语表目的，结构 清晰、无陷阱。 55. What do the authors of the study recommend to bridge the gender gap in early childhood education? A) Recruiting young men who have a passion for educating young children. B) Taking measures to attract prospective male teachers to work in the field. C) Persuading prospective fathers to consider a change in their career. D) Providing male teachers with more opportunities for advancement.

【定位】They recommend providing young men opportunities to work with children through training and volunteer programs, targeting groups of men who are considering a career change, such as fathers. 他们建议通过培训与志愿项目，给年轻男性提供与儿童一起工作的机会，并把目光投向考虑 转行的男性群体，例如父亲们。

【选项】A) 无中生有 Recruiting young men who have a passion for educating young children.给目标人 群加上 a passion for educating young children 的条件，但原文只说面向 young men 与「考虑转行的男性」，并没限定他们要「有热情」——属于无中生有。 B) ✓ 正确 providing young men opportunities to work with children through training and volunteer programs ↔Taking measures to attract prospective male teachers to work in the field groups of men who are considering a career change ↔prospective male teachers 预判强调「采取措施吸引潜在男性入行」，Taking measures to attract prospective male teachers to work in the field.恰好把「动作（taking measures）+对象 （prospective male teachers）+目的（work in the field）」三块都覆盖到位。 C) 偷换概念 Persuading prospective fathers to consider a change in their career.里 prospective fathers 指「准父亲」，但原文such as fathers指的是「已经是父亲的 人」，且原文是把父亲作为「考虑转行的男性」的一个例子，而非要去「说服准父亲转 行」——主体身份与动作方向都被偷换。 D) 与原文相反 Providing male teachers with more opportunities for advancement.谈的是给已经 在岗的男教师更多晋升机会，但原文P6的建议是「吸引尚未入行的人入行」，并非「给 在岗的更多晋升」——动作对象（在岗 vs 未入行）与动作类型（晋升 vs 进入）都与原 文相反。
